chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen Achieves Perfected Man and Rebirth - World of Immortality Ch398
chapter_meta_description: After seven months in the death world, Xiao Chen finally achieves flesh-and-blood rebirth as a Five-Colored Skeleton Perfected Man. He sets out for vengeance against the Giant King.
og_title: Xiao Chen's Resurrection: Perfected Man Reborn in World of Immortality Ch398
og_description: Witness the miraculous rebirth of Xiao Chen from a skeleton to a living Perfected Man, then his march to destroy the Giant King.
twitter_title: Xiao Chen Reborn as Perfected Man in Ch398
twitter_description: After months of cultivation, Xiao Chen returns to life with a perfected body and heads straight for vengeance.
